label: Teltonika RUTC40
description: An edge router with on-site compute: 1 WAN + 4 LAN at gigabit, a 4G modem, and enough CPU and storage to run containers at the branch rather than shipping every reading to a data centre.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUTC40 datasheet: 1 x WAN port 10/100/1000 Mbps and 4 x LAN ports 10/100/1000 Mbps (IEEE 802.3); 4G LTE modem. The datasheet states '4G' without naming the LTE category, so the cellular interface is modelled at the 100 Mbps Cat 4 class that every 4G model in this catalogue shares, and the note says so rather than implying a measured figure.
